basic_details.short_information: District Ganga Protection Committee Gaya (DGPC Gaya) has released the official District Project Officer Notification 2026 on its official website, https://gaya.nic.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the DGPC Gaya District Project Officer Recruitment 2026. Candidates up to 45 years of age with a Graduation degree from a recognized University, at least 2 years of relevant experience, and the required computer, communication, and management skills are eligible to submit their offline applications up to 10 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application form are available

qualification.details: District Project Officer: Graduation Degree in any discipline from a recognized University. Minimum 02 Years of working experience on education and awareness generation programmes on cleanliness drive, water bodies, Pollution abatement & sanitation Youth Mobilization. Good Working knowledge of MS Office & Internet. Strong Management, Liaison, Documentation & communication skills. Good command over English, Hindi and regional language.

salary_details.details: Rs. 36000 + 2500 (Establishment) + 2000 (TA/DA) + 500 (Mobile and Communication Charges) per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DGPC Gaya District Project Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.gaya.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DGPC Gaya District Project Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Project Officer post is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the District Project Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation Degree in any discipline from a recognized University. Additionally, a minimum of 02 years of working experience in relevant fields is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the District Project Officer position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the District Project Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 36000, along with additional allowances for establishment, TA/DA, and mobile/communication charges.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the District Project Officer position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of District Project Officer in the District Ganga Protection Committee Gaya.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key responsibilities of a District Project Officer?
faq.answer: The role involves working on education and awareness generation programs related to cleanliness drives, water bodies, pollution abatement, sanitation, and youth mobilization.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of applications followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Ganga Protection Committee Gaya, which is www.gaya.nic.in.
